newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - March 25.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

A VERY ENGLISH OSCAR TRIUMPH At the Oscars ceremony last night The English Patient became the most successful British film in history by winning in nine of the twelve categories in which it was nominated. The romantic war epic put the film on par with Hollywood films from a bygone era.
BARCLAYS TAKES HIT IN OPTIONS BLUNDER
Barclays Bank's investment banking arm BZW has written off 10 million stg in losses and has lost staff following the selling of complex financial derivatives at too low a price.
PAYOUT PLUS AS PRU WINS SCOTAM AUCTION

The Prudential is set to takeover Scottish Amicable in a deal worth almost 2.8 billion stg. The insurance giant has seen off rivals Abbey National and Australian Mutual Provident. Policyholders at Scotam are likely to benefit from a cash payout of an average 545 stg.

As dealers speculated on an interest rate rise in Britain as soon as the election is over, the pound rose against all currencies overnight. The market in the dollar was cautious today as US rise in interest rates is expected.
MINE MYSTERY DEEPENS IN THE BORNEO JUNGLE

The intrigue over Borneo's Busang gold mine deepens. The scandal involving the world's biggest gold deposit and the manoeuvrings of two of President Suharto's children appeared to be over with Canadian company Bre-X winning its battle with a compatriot. Now a puzzle hangs over the true value of the mine whose deposits are said to contain 12.5 billion stg worth of gold.
